label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparation of a bread-supplied, lantern-lit community hospitality gathering in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00. The mayor was told of a vaguely described hospitality meeting, but not the joint provisioning or hall setup. Bread coordination and hall delivery are supported by speech; lanterns and three organizers waiting in the hall support a gathering. A surprise celebration, its occasion, and deliberate secrecy are not established. The secretary knowingly helped schedule and escort the mayor, but the record does not establish knowledge of the undisclosed preparations; no additional knowing helpers are established.
